## Activity

During August 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 10 captures. This represents the activity recorded for the site during the month. The available capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading outcomes. The clinic should continue to maintain the same recording arrangements so that activity can be monitored consistently over time.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 20.0 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered when reviewing the capture process. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording those issues will support follow-up and help identify any repeated operational problems affecting image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This indicates that the central point of the recorded grading times was 1 day, although individual cases may have taken longer or less time. The referable results and the image-quality findings should be reviewed alongside the activity record to support routine site oversight and any required service improvement.
